description: Creates or retrieves the delivery certificate for ONE receiver. Requires: notification_request_send, notification_receiver_add → receiverId, notificationRequestId, caseFileId. 403 while the notification is DRAFT or that receiver is still READY_TO_SEND (see notification_receiver_list). Generate a UUID v4 for `id` once and reuse it when polling: the tool returns the existing certificate with that id instead of creating a duplicate. CERTIFYING → CERTIFIED; poll until CERTIFIED, when documentUrl is included. partial: true means it was issued before the receiver READ (NO_RESPONSE type) or ANSWERED (other types); for the final one, call again with a new id once it has.

embeddedDocuments.description: true embeds the notification's documents in the certificate (409 if the notification has none). Fixed when the certificate is created: to change it, use a new id.

name: notification_certificate_get
